question: From the given renowned personalities, which one was posthumously awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2025 in the field of Literature and Education?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M. T. Vasudevan Nair**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **M. T. Vasudevan Nair**, an acclaimed Indian author and screenplay writer, is known for his contributions to **Malayalam literature**. His works reflect deep insights into human emotions and social realities.
 
• He was **posthumously awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2025** in the field of **Literature and Education**, recognizing his lifetime achievements in enriching Indian literature and cinema.
 
• M. T. Vasudevan Nair is the recipient of several prestigious awards, including the **Jnanpith Award**, which is India’s highest literary honor. He also won multiple **National Film Awards** for his screenwriting prowess.
 
• His notable works include novels like **"Naalukettu,"** "Kaalam," and **"Randamoozham,"** which are regarded as masterpieces of Malayalam literature.
 
• He has made significant contributions to Malayalam cinema through his screenplays, many of which are considered classics. His storytelling showcases a unique blend of realism and artistic finesse.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Vibhushan:**

 
 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is the second-highest civilian award in India. It is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field, including arts, literature, science, and public services.
 
• Since its institution in **1954**, the award has been conferred upon individuals who have made significant contributions to their respective fields.
 
 
 
• **Malayalam Literature:**
 
 
• **Malayalam literature** is one of the richest literary traditions in India, with its roots tracing back to the 12th century.
 
• It encompasses a wide range of genres, including poetry, prose, drama, and short stories, reflecting Kerala’s culture and social ethos.
 
• Authors like **Thakazhi Sivasankara Pillai**, **Vallathol Narayana Menon**, and **M. T. Vasudevan Nair** have contributed significantly to its growth and recognition.
 
 
 
• **M. T. Vasudevan Nair’s Achievements:**
 
 
• He has been honored with the **Jnanpith Award** in **1995**, recognizing his contribution to literature.
 
• His novel **"Randamoozham"** (The Second Turn) is a retelling of the Mahabharata from the perspective of Bhima and is widely regarded as a literary masterpiece.
 
• He has also received **6 National Film Awards** for Best Screenplay, showcasing his versatility in storytelling across mediums.
 
 
 
• **Notable Screenplays:**
 
 
• M. T. Vasudevan Nair has written screenplays for iconic Malayalam films like **"Oru Vadakkan Veeragatha,"** "Panchagni," and **"Perumthachan."**
 
• His screenplays are celebrated for their deep characterizations, emotional depth, and cultural authenticity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Jnanpith Award:**

 
 
• It is India’s highest literary honor, established in **1961**.
 
• The award recognizes outstanding contributions to literature in any of the **22 scheduled languages** mentioned in the **Eighth Schedule of the Constitution**.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards:**
 
 
• The Padma Awards include three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service).
 
• These awards are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Literature and Education Category:**
 
 
• This category in the Padma Awards recognizes individuals who have made significant contributions to the field of literature and education.
 
• It includes authors, poets, scholars, and educators who have impacted society through their work.
